name: side-chat
description: Ask Claude a side question in a pane next to your work. The main conversation never sees it. Works like the desktop app's /btw.

yourColor.title: Your text color
yourColor.description: Colour of your questions in the side chat.

claudeColor.title: Claude's text color
claudeColor.description: Colour of Claude's answers in the side chat.

instructions.title: Side chat instructions
instructions.description: Your own instructions for the side chat, added to every question. Example: answer in plain words, two lines at most, no code unless asked.

takeKeyboard.title: Side chat takes the keyboard when opened
takeKeyboard.description: On: /btw puts the cursor in the side chat so you can type at once; press Esc to go back to the main prompt. Off: the main prompt keeps the keyboard, and dropped screenshots stay there; ask with /btw <question>.

agentModel.title: Side chat agent model
agentModel.description: Model for agents called with /btw @name. default: the agent's own model. Change it on the fly by typing /model haiku in the pane.
